note: FILL BEFORE USING FOR EVIDENCE. yaw_deg_true is the compass bearing the camera boresight points at, degrees TRUE. hfov_deg is the horizontal field of view of the FULL frame -- measure it, do not copy a spec sheet: point the camera at two landmarks whose bearings you know, put each at a frame edge, the difference is the HFOV. yaw_uncertainty_deg of 5.0 is what a phone compass gives you; a surveyed bearing gets 1.0. This number goes straight into every bearing sigma and therefore into every SPOOF confidence.
